incident: Some parallel agent importers inferred the newest shared image file rather than the output_hint from their own tool call.
responsibility: Root integration did not catch the importer assumption before candidate QA. Root acknowledged and corrected it.
legacy_scope: Legacy agent-produced gear/icon raws before exact output capture may not be attributable to their stored prompts. Keep all old files; do not count as current verified sources.
incorrect_failure_interpretation: Cross imports are importer/provenance failures, not evidence that the requested original concept could not be generated.
corrective_action: Per-call returned output_hint UUID file captured before import, provider/raw SHA comparison, prompt/reference SHA, new revision with explicit current selection indexes.
new_generated_source_binding: Only current source/provider copy verification establishes exact current-call binding. A visually valid legacy reference image retains legacy UNKNOWN attribution.
known_other_case: R05_G4 r002 result metadata was lost; no inferred file was imported. Bounded r003 exact-call retry recorded. Actual generation cost of the lost call UNKNOWN.
